name: Artichoke Appetizer
description: A warm, cheesy artichoke appetizer perfect for serving with bread or crackers.

recipeInstructions.text: Drain artichoke hearts.
Combine artichoke hearts with cheese, mayonnaise, garlic salt, and green onion in a casserole dish.
Sprinkle parsley over the top.
Bake at 350°F for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serve with bread or crackers.

keywords: artichoke appetizer, cheesy dip, party snack

_similar.name: Noodles with Hamburg
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground hamburger, macaroni, and a blend of vegetables and cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: In a frying pan, brown the hamburger with celery and onions (if using). Drain excess fat.
Add garlic powder, oregano, salt, tomato soup, corn, and canned tomatoes to the browned hamburger mixture. Stir to combine.
Simmer the mixture slowly for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook macaroni according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
Combine the cooked macaroni with the hamburger and sauce mixture. Stir well.
If using cheese, heat it until melted and mix into the noodle and hamburger mixture.
Serve hot.

_similar.keywords: hamburger casserole, noodle dish, comfort food

_similar.name: Green Beans and Artichokes
_similar.description: A savory side dish featuring green beans and artichoke hearts mixed with garlic, onion, and Romano cheese.
recipeIngredient: 1 (14 oz) can artichokes, drained and quartered
½ cup freshly grated Romano cheese
1 (10 oz) pkg frozen french-style green beans, cooked and drained

recipeInstructions.text: Saute the onion and garlic in olive oil until the onion is softened.
Stir in bread crumbs and cook until they absorb the oil.
Add green beans, artichoke hearts, and cheese. Combine thoroughly.
Heat slowly to soften the cheese. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

_similar.keywords: green beans, artichokes, Romano cheese, side dish

_similar.name: Spaghetti Sauce
_similar.description: A rich and flavorful homemade spaghetti sauce made with tomato paste, tomato sauce, and ground beef, simmered for several hours.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all ingredients except ground beef in a large pot. Cook gently for at least 2 hours.
Sauté the ground beef until browned, drain off fat, and add to the sauce.
Continue cooking gently for another 2 hours.

_similar.keywords: spaghetti sauce, homemade tomato sauce, Italian sauce

_similar.name: Spaghetti Sauce
_similar.description: A hearty spaghetti sauce made with ground hamburger, vegetables, and a blend of herbs and spices.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute the onion, celery, and garlic until tender.
Add the ground hamburger and brown.
Add the remaining ingredients and simmer for several hours.

_similar.name: Sloppy Joe Squares
_similar.description: A layered casserole featuring a sloppy joe beef mixture between two layers of crescent roll dough, topped with mozzarella cheese and baked until golden brown.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the beef, onions, and spices in a skillet over medium heat until the meat is no longer red.
Blend in flour to thicken the mixture.
Add 1¼ cups water, ketchup, and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.
Preheat oven to 350°F and line a 9×13 inch pan with 1 package of crescent rolls.
Spread the beef mixture evenly over the layer of rolls.
Top the beef mixture with mozzarella cheese.
Cover with the second package of crescent dinner rolls, ensuring the dough touches the edges of the pan.
Bake at 350°F until the crescent rolls are browned.
Serve with a salad.

_similar.keywords: sloppy joe, casserole, crescent rolls, beef
